posts.caption: Biscuit found the warm spot on the west side of the house. He is not getting up.
Long day. Biscuit is flat on the kitchen tile, and the fireworks haven't even started.
Sunday walk with Biscuit. He took the long way around the block, then sat.
Biscuit on the back step this evening. Still warm, and he is in no hurry.
Monsoon season starts today. Dust storms and power flickers are hard on AC systems, so here are five things you can do this week to stay ahead of a no-cool call. Save this one for later. 🌩️

Excessive heat warning for the Valley from Wednesday through Sunday, with highs up to 116. Cooling stations at libraries and community centers are open daily with water and AC. Please check on older neighbors, and walk your dogs early. ☀️💧
Peer reviewed by every tech who has been in an attic this week. 🥵
Happy Fourth from all of us at Desert Air! Our office is closed Friday, July 3. If your AC goes out over the long weekend, call (602) 555-0191 and our on-call tech will take care of you. 🇺🇸
Martes de tacos 🌮 Al pastor off the trompo, asada, cabeza and lengua, all day. Bring the whole family. 59th Ave and Thomas.

⚠️ SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING for west Phoenix, Maryvale, Glendale and Tolleson until 8:15 PM. Gusts to 60 mph, blowing dust and heavy rain. Expect power outages and downed branches. Get inside and stay off the roads if you can.
Welcome back, Cartwright families! Today is the first day of school. Please drive slowly near campuses, watch for students walking, and have a great first day. 🍎
Fall schedule is here! Eight Saturdays, every game kicks off at 9:00, please arrive by 8:30. The full schedule went out by email today. Let's go Strikers! ⚽💛🖤
Yes, it's still 108 out. Fall tune-ups are open anyway. Book a morning visit now and your heat will be ready for the first cold night. desertairmechanical.com/tune-up or (602) 555-0191.

This Saturday! Labor Day weekend means we're open Saturday, Sunday AND Monday, 6 AM to 2 PM. Come early, it's still hot out. Tools, plants, toys, furniture, food... if you need it, somebody out here has it.
GAME DAY! Home opener vs Glendale Rush, 9:00 kickoff at Maryvale Park, Field 2. Bring water and a chair. Let's go! ⚽
It's supposed to hit 99 today, which in Phoenix means fall is here. ☕ Café de olla latte is back: cinnamon, piloncillo and a little orange peel. Hot or iced, we won't judge.
Enjoy fall recess, Cartwright families! There is no school Monday, October 5 through Friday, October 9. Classes resume Monday, October 12. 🍂
FINAL: Strikers 3, Avondale Fury 1! Big team effort today. Thank you families for bringing the noise. Back at practice Tuesday. 💛🖤
Every shop in Phoenix, every October. Tag your dispatcher.
Heads up, soccer families: Field 2 at Maryvale Park closes for irrigation repairs starting Thursday, October 15. Crews expect to have it back in about two weeks. Fields 1, 3 and 4 stay open.
FIELD CHANGE for Saturday: we're on Field 3 at Maryvale Park because of the irrigation work on Field 2. Same time, 9:00 kickoff, please arrive by 8:30. Check your email for Yesi's note from today.
Last home game of the fall! Strikers vs Laveen Lions, 9:00 at Maryvale Park, Field 2. Costumes after the game, not during. 🎃⚽
